up: Return the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compound records tested in assay CHEMBL1040694. For each activity record, include the CHEMBL ID of the compound, the activity type (e.g., IC50, Ki), the relation, the value, the units, and the canonical SMILES string of the compound structure.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'
